t: The Milwaukee Reaming Pen is a robust deburring tool designed for professional use. It provides fast and easy deburring of copper tubing and PVC, ensuring clean, smooth pipe edges. This essential plumbing and electrical hand tool is ideal for electricians and plumbers working on site, ensuring efficient pipe preparation. Its durable all-metal construction withstands demanding jobsite conditions, while the heat-treated, black oxide-coated steel blade offers extended service life. A slip-resistant pocket clip allows convenient storage and quick access.
b: Suitable for Cutting PVC, Copper & Plastic
Black Oxide-Coated Blade Extends Service Life
